current_stage.name: D115: Tsushima/Goto z8-11 gap genuinely fixed -- rebuilding final archive
current_stage.description: Root cause found (D115): downsampling_covering.py combines the whole Tsushima/Goto region into one z6-level chained work item (6-54-25-{8..11}-downsampling.csv), which was blocked the entire time by 2 missing ocean-only aggregation outputs (7-108-50-12, 7-108-51-12 -- East China Sea, jpnationalsea-only, stale .done markers with no actual file) causing DOWNSAMPLING_STRICT to skip the whole chain every run. Regenerated those 2 items, reran downsampling -- national backlog is now genuinely 0/8223 incomplete. Verified real elevation data (std 22-122m, up to 886m) now decodes at all previously-missing z8-11 coordinates -- confirmed fixed, not just re-bundled. Also found and fixed (this session): get_pmtiles_folder() needed a temporary fallback to the pre-D107 flat layout, since 1-go production data predates the 1.5-go layer-namespace split (marked remove-before-flight for 1.5-go). Now rebuilding bundle+merge+cluster+overview-splice for real, then local verification, then republish approval.
